panel_bounds_note: Broad acquisition windows enclosing each gel and surrounding space. Not lane boundaries, expected sample counts, or reference calls. Reviewers draw all lane regions themselves.
band_reference: Manually clicked centers of definite visible bands. Uncertain bands and unreadable rectangles are recorded separately.
matching: Within each independently drawn readable sample lane, maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching, then minimum total absolute y displacement. Archived predicted lane labels are not used for spatial matching.
exclusion_policy: Marker, gap, unreadable and unresolved-role lanes are not sample evaluation lanes. Predictions within pre-recorded unreadable rectangles or 3 native pixels of an uncertain-band y coordinate in that lane are excluded. Definite reference centers overlapping an exclusion are rejected. All exclusions and out-of-scope predictions are counted separately.
scope_warning: Lane-conditioned localization agreement with a human reading of a printed image. Not whole-dataset recovery, original biological band truth, or an external test set. Same image was used during development.
annotation_policy: Do not view comparison/ predictions during annotation. State any prior exposure honestly. An additional reader unfamiliar with algorithm outputs provides stronger independent evidence. One reader does not establish inter-reader reliability.
tolerance_note: Tolerances are analyst-specified native-image localization allowances, locked before new manual annotations. They are not inferred biological size tolerances and are not optimized after scores are seen.
